about.p1: Every line of my code is hand-written. No page builders, no copy-pasted themes. Just HTML, CSS and JavaScript, shaped until it feels right.
about.p2: I'm 24, based in Tehran, with an associate degree in programming and a B.Sc. in computer engineering in progress. I started with C# and SQL, spent time programming ARM microcontrollers, and settled on the front-end. Off the keyboard I follow the markets, so I think in data, timing and risk.
